patterns: Doomsday drip-feed: 7 Avengers: Doomsday posts made about 50% of hit views. The new poster did 9,009,572 on DiscussingFilm, the Magneto vs Doctor Doom first look 4,954,642, a Magneto teaser line 1,698,347, and RDJ's Doom artwork 780,937. One asset, many single-beat posts.

AI-in-filmmaking is the hottest argument: Fincher saying he used AI to redo dialogue and lip movements in Cliff Booth did 2,143,379 (DiscussingFilm) and 100,147 (FilmUpdates); Disney Animation's Jared Bush on gen AI copying their style did 257,583.
Odd-couple casting wins: 'Gordon Ramsay will host Top Gear' did 2,168,221. A famous name in an unexpected job travels further than a normal casting.
Production milestones with a date in the hook: 'Filming has wrapped on The Hunt for Gollum' with its release date did 1,446,570; The Pitt S3 premiere date did 332,517 and 229,744.
Creators admitting flaws get shared: Francis Lawrence saying the last 40 minutes of I Am Legend are a failure did 231,231; ATRightMovies' Keaton clip answering Batman doubters was its best (127,495).
Small accounts win on personal takes and either/or questions: CinemaTweets1's five-star 'one of my favorite films ever?' Cliff Booth reaction did 105,598; ATRightMovies' 'Jaws or Raiders' did 16,662.
narrative_synthesis: Thanksgiving-eve was a Doomsday day (about 50% of hit views) with a second storyline on AI in filmmaking after Fincher said most re-recorded dialogue in Cliff Booth was done with AI. Odd-couple casting (Ramsay on Top Gear) and production wraps with dates were the other big hooks.
